description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Sqrt' within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods for calculating square roots, including the standard square root and the square root of the product of a number and pi, with support for array inputs and validation.

classes.name: Sqrt
classes.description: Provides static methods to compute square roots and square root of number times pi, with argument validation.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description: Calculates the square root of a number or array of numbers with validation, returning errors if invalid.

methods.name: pi
methods.description: Calculates the square root of (number * pi) with validation, supporting array inputs.
